description: Preview import of one completed After Effects single-file render into an existing Premiere bin. Reads both connected hosts and binds approval to file metadata and project/bin identity. Does not render, import, or edit a timeline.

ae_project_path.description: Exact open, saved After Effects project path.

approved_workspace_path.description: Existing absolute workspace containing both saved projects and the rendered media.

output_path.description: Existing completed .mov, .mp4, .mxf, .avi or .wav render; image sequences are not supported.

premiere_project_path.description: Exact open, saved Premiere project path.

queue_item_index.description: One-based AE render queue item index, as returned by enqueue_after_effects_render.

target_bin_id.description: Exact node ID of an existing destination bin, never a name.

name: preview_after_effects_render_handoff

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Preview After Effects Render Handoff
